caption: Søby Harbour, Søby
composition: A stone mole, fishing boats, and low red roofs · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Søby harbour is a stone mole with a few small fishing boats and low red-tiled houses, opening onto a wind-chopped sea. The quay is empty. The night is partly cloudy, about 12.9°C. Broken cloud hides much of the moon. No ferry name is readable.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Søby harbour at night, a mole and low red roofs on Ærø
